about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

“Dark Adelita” is a boss rush style game, you advance in each level to dodge enemies and their attacks, you will have a varied arsenal to make your way through the enemies and reach the face-to-face encounter against the boss of the level, each legend at the end of the levels will have an epic battle to defeat him.

STORY

In the year 1918, as Mexico struggles to rise from the Mexican Revolution, a dark evil looms over the country. Creatures from Mexican legends have come to life, fueled by the fears and suffering of a devastated people. In this context, Angela, a brave Adelita, embarks on a mission to confront these entities and free the people from their oppression. Armed with her rifle, special abilities and unwavering determination, she will travel through different regions until she comes face to face with the legends.

The roads are shrouded in darkness, filled with whispers that seem to come from the earth itself. The wind carries wails that freeze the blood, and dancing shadows lurk around every corner. The terror intensifies with every step, as Angela discovers that these creatures seek not only to destroy, but also to claim her soul. Mexican legends come to life with unimaginable ferocity.

With each creature she defeats, Angela plunges deeper into a nightmarish world, where the boundary between the real and the supernatural blurs. Her confrontations are not only a test of strength, but also of mental endurance. In this fight against the shadows, courage and cunning will be her only allies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 | Windows 11
  • Processor: 64bit Intel compatible Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
